title: Crunchy Arancini Bites
description: A snack-sized version of the Italian street food arancini, these crunchy fried rice balls are filled with a flavorful mixture of fluffy risotto and nutty ingredients.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine cooked risotto, cooked rice, nutty breadcrumbs, and arancini seasoning (if using). Mix well to combine.
2. Using your hands, shape the mixture into small balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Once the oil is hot, carefully place the arancini balls into the skillet and fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
5. Remove the arancini from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
6. Serve the arancini hot and enjoy!
7. Optional: you can also bake the arancini in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
